fusions.name: Rafter Pounce
fusions.desc: Drops you onto a target up to 6 tiles away for 12 damage, leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Toyed With
fusions.desc: Butts a target at or below 30% health for 18 damage, consuming every affliction on it to add 1.4 times their remaining damage to the hit, and 50% more damage for each one consumed.

fusions.name: Soft Hooves
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Always Lands Upright
fusions.desc: Once every 300 seconds, a blow that would kill you leaves you at 1 health instead.
